---
name: unslop
description: Cut AI tells from any writing. Apply to every doc, comment, commit message and reply you write.
---

# Unslop

Rewrite text to remove these patterns. Keep the meaning.

- No em dashes. Use a period or comma.
- No -ing filler ("highlighting", "ensuring", "showcasing"). Delete it or give the source.
- No AI vocabulary: delve, crucial, pivotal, tapestry, testament, underscore, vibrant, landscape, intricate.
- Write "is" or "has", not "serves as", "stands as", "boasts".
- No "not just X but Y". State the point.
- No rule-of-three padding. Use the natural number of items.
- No vague attributions ("experts say"). Name the source or cut.
- No filler ("in order to", "it is important to note"), chatbot phrases, flattery, or generic conclusions.
- Use the plain word: "use", not "utilize" or "leverage".
- Use active voice and name the actor.
- Use sentence case headings, no emojis, bold sparingly.
